title: Fir3fr0gPersonalPack
description: A personal Vanilla+ esque pack aimed towards Relaxing minecraft gameplay with the option to make a video out of the gameplay later (through Replay Mod).
body:
This is a personal Vanilla+ esque modpack that I curated to cater to turning my brain off and Enjoying playing minecraft, while also allowing the possibility for YouTube projects! Features MANY optimization mods, and several quality of life mods (I urge you to check out the modlist).

I'm mainly publicizing this so I can easily play and update this Modpack with my Wife.
